'''Gan Alno''' was the head of [[Raynor Mining Enterprises]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the conflict, Alno hired a treasure hunter to locate the [[Platinum Pickaxe]], a fabled pickaxe once owned by the company's founder [[Trebold Raynor]], on [[Trebold Raynor's homeworld|Raynor's homeworld]].<ref name="Platinum Pickaxe" />
